description: Generic coordinated project-context bundle. Values and claims must be filled from the target project.

conditional_project_files..ai/HARDWARE.md: physical hardware or project wiring is identifiable
conditional_project_files..ai/SOFTWARE.md: build system, dependencies, runtime or development configuration must be maintained
conditional_project_files..ai/DECISIONS.md: technical decisions or ADRs must be maintained
conditional_project_files..ai/ARCHITECTURE.md: complex boundaries, flows or state machines need a dedicated explanation
conditional_project_files..ai/PROTOCOL.md: a communication contract must be maintained
conditional_project_files..ai/TESTING.md: testing strategy or evidence must be maintained
